A CLI for accessing Omni API.

Usage:
  omnictl [command]

Available Commands:
  apply           Create or update resource using YAML file as an input
  audit-log       Read audit log from Omni
  cluster         Cluster-related subcommands.
  completion      generate completion script for a specified shell
  config          Manage the client configuration file (omniconfig)
  delete          Delete a specific resource by ID or all resources of the type.
  download        Download installer media
  get             Get a specific resource or list of resources.
  help            show help for any command
  infraprovider   Manage infra providers
  kubeconfig      Download the admin kubeconfig of a cluster
  machine-logs    Get logs for a machine
  serviceaccount  Manage service accounts
  support         Download the support bundle for a cluster
  talosconfig     Download an admin talosconfig.
  user            User-related subcommands.
  version         show omnictl version information

Flags:
      --context string            The context to be used. Defaults to the selected context in
                                  the omniconfig file.
      --insecure-skip-tls-verify  Skip TLS verification for the Omni GRPC and HTTP API
                                  endpoints.
      --omniconfig string         The path to the omni configuration file. Defaults to
                                  'OMNICONFIG' env variable if set, otherwise the config directory according to the XDG
                                  specification.
  -h, --help                      show help, then exit

Use "omnictl [command] --help" for more information about a command.
